field_meanings.space_snapshot: Short statement of current usable space surface, not authority.
field_meanings.active_controls: Layer map, compact asset index, no-mutation boundary, and router/contract files used.
field_meanings.relevant_assets: Bounded list of files relevant to the user's current instruction.
field_meanings.hold_or_authority_boundary: Explicit statement that HOLD/proposal is not authority/current-position/registry.
field_meanings.missing_handles: Any task packet, reentry record, validation, or index handle needed before execution.
field_meanings.promotion_status: Usually HOLD unless user explicitly approves a bounded apply lane.
